021import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.inventory.InventoryWrapper;
022import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.inventory.InventoryWrapperManager;
023import org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack;
024import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
025import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
026
027import java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture;
028
029/**
030 * ShopInventory
031 *
032 * @author creatorfromhell
033 * @since 6.3.0.0
034 */
035public interface ShopInventory {
036
037  /**
038   * Add x ItemStack to the shop inventory
039   *
040   * @param paramItemStack The ItemStack you want add
041   * @param paramInt       How many you want add
042   */
043  void add(@NotNull ItemStack paramItemStack, int paramInt);
044
045  /**
046   * Remove x ItemStack from the shop inventory
047   *
048   * @param paramItemStack Want removed ItemStack
049   * @param paramInt       Want remove how many
050   */
051  void remove(@NotNull ItemStack paramItemStack, int paramInt);
052
053  /**
054   * Gets the shop Inventory
055   *
056   * @return Inventory
057   */
058  @Nullable
059  InventoryWrapper getInventory();
060
061  /**
062   * Gets the InventoryWrapper provider name (the plugin name who register it), usually is
063   * QuickShop
064   *
065   * @return InventoryWrapper
066   */
067  @NotNull
068  String getInventoryWrapperProvider();
069
070  /**
071   * Get shop remaining space.
072   *
073   * @return Remaining space.
074   */
075  int getRemainingSpace();
076
077  /**
078   * Get shop remaining stock.
079   *
080   * @return Remaining stock.
081   */
082  int getRemainingStock();
083
084  /**
085   * Asynchronously retrieves the number of items currently in stock in the shop.
086   *
087   * @return A CompletableFuture representing the remaining stock count. The future completes
088   *         with the value of the stock count once the information becomes available.
089   */
090  CompletableFuture<Integer> getRemainingStockAsync();
091
092  int getShopStackingAmount();
093
094  /**
095   * Check if shop out of space or out of stock
096   *
097   * @return true if out of space or out of stock
098   */
099  boolean inventoryAvailable();
100
101  /**
102   * Asynchronously determines whether the shop's inventory is available,
103   * indicating that it is neither out of space nor out of stock.
104   *
105   * @return A CompletionStage that completes with a Boolean value indicating
106   *         whether the inventory is available (true) or not (false).
107   */
108  CompletableFuture<Boolean> inventoryAvailableAsync();
109
110  /**
111   * Check the target ItemStack is matches with this shop's item.
112   *
113   * @param paramItemStack Target ItemStack.
114   *
115   * @return Matches
116   */
117  boolean matches(@NotNull ItemStack paramItemStack);
118
119  void setInventory(@NotNull InventoryWrapper wrapper, @NotNull InventoryWrapperManager manager);
120}
